name: google-search-console
description: MCP server for Google Search Console: search analytics, URL inspection, sitemaps and site management via OAuth2.

GSC_CLIENT_ID.title: Google OAuth Client ID
GSC_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client ID from Google Cloud Console (Google Search Console API enabled).

GSC_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
GSC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client secret from Google Cloud Console.

GSC_READONLY.title: Read-only mode
GSC_READONLY.description: Set to "true" to hide write tools (add/delete site, submit/delete sitemap). Default: false.
